answer: The keystone here is Thatcher reed proof lodged with the thatchers charter, which costs an honest agent 3-year apprenticeship, 222 supervised reeds, guild exam, 43 POA annual fee, renewal and a farm a hundred times over. A farm either pays 52664 POA up front or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool. The lotus names the issuer, the pigment names the price, and the anchor names the date: a forger must forge all three. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
